Some spaces are designed to soothe, and the Stanhope Hydraulic Bed does just that. From the moment you step into your bedroom, its cocooning, fully upholstered frame invites you to unwind, wrapping you in quiet luxury. The plush, channeled headboard, gently angled for support, adds an element of refined texture—perfect for late-night reads and slow Sunday mornings.

The low-profile design maintains a contemporary edge, ensuring the Stanhope fits seamlessly into any modern bedroom. The design is accentuated by chrome-plated legs for a contemporary touch. Beneath its seamless form lies a hidden indulgence—a generous hydraulic storage system, effortlessly accessible yet completely out of sight.

More than a bed, Stanhope is an invitation to find your own moments of serenity.

Available in fabric upholstery: Shitake Beige, Baltic Blue, Urban Grey, and leatherette upholstery: Sienna Brown.

Available in King & Queen size options.

Recommended mattress size for King: 78 x 72 inches.

Recommended mattress size for Queen: 78 x 60 inches. Thickness - 4 to 6 inches

Available in Hydraulic Storage option.
